lines.text: The psalmist will thank the LORD with all his heart among the upright in the assembly.
God's work is splendid and majestic, and His righteousness endures forever.
The LORD provides food for those who fear Him and remembers His temple forever.
He showed His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations.
The LORD has sent judgment to His people, and the fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom.
